text:
maria-fin: Heads up — noticed an odd pair of line items on the April invoice for asia-east2 GPUs: a negative 'tariff adjustment' (-$22,304.00) followed immediately by a positive 'region surcharge' (+$22,304.00). Looks like a reversal/misclassification. Anyone else seeing this?

raj-infra: I see it too. It landed on our reserved commitment ID. Raw lines from the bill look like:
```
LineItem: SKU:COMPUTE-ACCEL-ASIA-EAST2-TARIFF_ADJ  -22304.00
LineItem: SKU:COMPUTE-ACCEL-ASIA-EAST2-SURCHG  +22304.00
```

billing-bot: Automated: Detected anomaly for project 'redwood-prod-asia' — anomaly score 0.91 — created ticket BILL-4521.

zoe-ops: ping @sam-cloud — can you confirm if there was a tariff rule flip on 2026-04-01? cc @alex-eng — this touches reserved capacity offsets.

alex-eng: Most likely a rate-card metadata remap. When providers change regional tariff classification they sometimes reclassify previous adjustments and re-apply charges. Can someone run a lineitem query against our billing BigQuery? Quick snippet:
```sql
SELECT invoice_month, sku, commitment_id, amount FROM `billing.gcp_lineitems` WHERE invoice_id='INV-2026-04-2789' AND sku LIKE '%ACCEL%';
```

maria-fin: Invoice ID is `INV-2026-04-2789`. Commitment ID `CMT-98765`. Billing link: https://console.cloud.example/billing/INV-2026-04-2789

raj-infra: Ran a quick group query — negative tariff adj billed to `billing_account:reserved-commits` and the positive surcharge billed to `billing_account:standard`. Looks like the reserved offset didn't apply to the remapped SKU. Quick check query used:
```sql
SELECT billing_account, SUM(amount) as total FROM `billing.gcp_lineitems` WHERE invoice_id='INV-2026-04-2789' GROUP BY billing_account;
```

sam-cloud: @zoe-ops hi — provider support here. We see a metadata remap for Asia tariffs on 2026-04-01 that created duplicated reversal/charge flows for some commit-linked invoices. Case CS-110234 opened; engineering investigating. ETA for a backfill fix: 48-72h. Will update BILL-4521.

zoe-ops: Can we escalate? This is >$20k and affects our reserved commit reporting for the month.

maria-fin: If the provider backfill doesn't net to zero for our account, we need a manual credit. @sam-cloud can you confirm whether the backfill will produce net-zero accounting so we avoid manual adjustments?

sam-cloud: If backfill completes successfully it will net to zero automatically. If not, we will issue a manual credit and confirm via BILL-4521.

alex-eng: In parallel, let's add a short GA rule in our reporting ETL to collapse matching opposite-signed SKUs with the same SKU code + commitment_id so this doesn't pollute month-end dashboards. Regex + commit id match, will be temporary.

raj-infra: I'll add a small script to the ETL and tag entries as 'provider-tariff-remap' so finance can filter. PR incoming in ~30m.

maria-fin: :thumbsup: Please also persist all raw lineitems and audit logs for reclaim evidence if needed. Save screenshots too.

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-4521 updated: linked provider case CS-110234. Assigned to zoe-ops, sam-cloud.

zoe-ops: Assigning to myself. I'll follow up with provider support and update status here. Thanks everyone.
